title: Compliance Administrator - Leading Recruitment Company
description:
Join Prospero Teaching - Where Passion Meets Purpose in Education!

For over 20 years, Prospero Teaching has been a trusted leader in connecting teaching and support staff with schools, academies, and nurseries across the UK and internationally. We proudly offer our services to a broad range of educational settings, including EYFS, Primary, Secondary, Further Education, SEN, and PRUs.

About the Role

As a Compliance Administrator, you will be a key member of our compliance team, responsible for ensuring candidates meet the necessary regulatory and internal requirements to work within the education sector. You will play a vital role in maintaining compliance with industry standards and fostering a smooth recruitment process for candidates.

Key Responsibilities
- Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure candidates meet all compliance standards for the education sector.
- Follow established operational processes and procedures to ensure adherence to regulations and industry standards.
- Guide and support candidates throughout the recruitment process.
- Conduct compliance checks, including but not limited to right-to-work, DBS, reference, and employment history verifications.
- Maintain and update accurate candidate records.
- Organise and verify candidate documentation.
- Respond to both internal and external inquiries efficiently and professionally.

About You

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented individual with:
- A good general education (minimum GCSEs in Maths and English, grades A-C, or equivalent).
- Strong relationship-building skills.
- The ability to work effectively under deadlines.
- Excellent administrative and organizational abilities, with a talent for prioritizing tasks.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- An understanding of confidentiality and data protection.
- A proactive problem-solving mindset.
- A commitment to safeguarding practices.

Benefits
- Competitive salary with a commission structure.
- Ongoing training and opportunities for professional development.
- Clear career advancement prospects within the company.
- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
- Private healthcare.
- Quarterly performance-based incentives.

Join us and be part of a team that's helping drive one of the UK's fastest-growing recruitment firms forward.

title: Internal Recruiter
description:
At CV-Library, we have a simple vision: to help the world to work and we are looking for exceptional and talented people to help us realise this vision in both UK and overseas markets.

We are in a period of focused internal investment, following a year of key strategic acquisitions and significant investment across all parts of the business from Tech and Data to People and HR, there's never been a more exciting time to join us or a better place to grow your career!

Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00-17:30
Location: Fleet, Hampshire
Working Pattern: Hybrid - 3 days a week on site

We're now looking for an Internal Recruiter to join us and take ownership of the full recruitment lifecycle across a diverse range of roles and business functions. Working closely with hiring managers, you'll attract, engage and hire top talent through a proactive, data-driven approach, helping to shape our workforce while delivering an exceptional candidate experience from attraction through to onboarding.

Key Responsibilities:
- Take full ownership of the end-to-end recruitment process across the CV-Library Group, advising hiring managers on requirements, salary expectations, timelines and the current candidate market
- Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and agree recruitment strategies, particularly for hard to fill and specialist roles using data and market insight to identify trends, improve hiring activity and support better recruitment decisions
- Source, screen and assess candidates across a variety of business functions
- Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future recruitment requirements
- Proactively source candidates using CV-Library, LinkedIn, employee referrals, talent pools, networking and other direct sourcing methods to attract high-quality talent
- Coordinate interviews, assessments and candidate communications, maintaining accurate recruitment data, reporting and ATS records
- Manage offer processes, negotiations and onboarding handovers and day-1 inductions
- Provide an exceptional candidate experience at every stage of the hiring journey
- Identify candidates who have the right skills, experience and alignment with CV-Library's values
- Manage relationships with recruitment agencies and external suppliers
- Support employer brand and talent attraction activity to help increase awareness of the CV-Library Group as an employer, including promotion and administration of the employee referral programme
- Monitor and report upon recruitment activity and key metrics, including time to hire, source of hire, offer acceptance and agency spend
- Work closely with HR and hiring managers to support workforce planning and upcoming recruitment requirements
- Ensure all recruitment practices are fair, compliant and meet company policies and employment legislation

Skills & Experience:
- Previous recruitment experience gained within an internal acquisition team or recruitment agency environment
- Proven experience managing multiple vacancies and delivering successful hires across a range of disciplines and seniority levels
- Strong candidate sourcing skills, including the use of job boards, LinkedIn, talent pools, referrals and networking techniques
- Experience partnering with hiring managers to understand requirements and provide recruitment advice
- Experience recruiting for hard-to-fill or specialist roles using proactive sourcing and headhunting techniques
- Good understanding of the recruitment market, including salary expectations, candidate availability and sourcing trends
- Experience using recruitment data and reporting to track performance and identify areas for improvement
- Experience conducting candidate screenings and assessing suitability against role requirements
- Ability to build strong relationships with hiring managers, candidates and other stakeholders
- Excellent communication, organisation and time management skills
- Experience using Application Tracking Systems (ATS), CRM systems or other recruitment technologies

We are actively committed to promoting a fully diverse and inclusive workforce and we welcome applications for this role from all candidates who meet the key requirements.

Please do not hesitate to get in touch should you require any reasonable adjustments to assist with your application.

title: Onboarding Coordinator
description:
Onboarding Coordinator Join an Ambitious Team Driving Operational Excellence

This is a pivotal position within the Group Support team, responsible for managing the onboarding and ongoing compliance of contractors operating within highly regulated industries.

You'll oversee the full contractor lifecycle, from initial onboarding through to contract extensions, compliance renewals and client-specific changes. Workloads can vary significantly, with some contractors onboarding months in advance while others require mobilisation at very short notice, making this a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Success in this role comes from balancing exceptional attention to detail with commercial awareness. You'll be expected to follow established processes while also having the confidence to question information, identify potential risks and challenge stakeholders when something doesn't look right.

Working closely with Sales, Agency Pay, Contractors and Clients, you'll play a key role in ensuring compliance requirements are met while delivering a positive and seamless onboarding experience.

Key Responsibilities

Managing the end-to-end onboarding process for new contractors.

Ensuring contractor records meet regulatory, legislative and client-specific compliance requirements.

Processing contract change requests, including extensions and amendments.

Supporting ongoing contractor compliance through document renewals and status updates.

Conducting client audits and identifying compliance gaps, risks and improvement opportunities.

Building strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Participating in client meetings, particularly with high-volume accounts.

Monitoring onboarding activity and prioritising workload across the team.

Continuously reviewing and improving processes to drive efficiency and enhance the contractor experience.

Working with systems including Bullhorn and TIFO to maintain accurate records and compliance documentation.

Supporting automation initiatives and identifying opportunities to streamline administrative processes.

What's in it for you?

Be Part of an Ambitious Team with Big Goals
This is a team that's striving for excellence, with a clear aspiration of being recognised as Team of the Year. You'll be joining a driven, tenacious group that takes pride in delivering outstanding results while supporting one another along the way.

A Varied Role with Real Business Impact
No two days are the same. You'll work across multiple departments, build relationships throughout the business and play a key role in enhancing the customer journey. This isn't a role where you're siloed into one area; you'll have visibility, influence and the opportunity to make a genuine impact.

Innovation Meets Human Connection
The team embraces new technologies and innovative ways of working, while recognising that strong relationships remain at the heart of success. You'll use technology to improve efficiency, but you'll also be encouraged to pick up the phone, collaborate with stakeholders and build genuine connections.

We are looking for individuals who:

We are looking for individuals who:

Thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Have exceptional attention to detail and take pride in getting things right first time.

Are tenacious and resilient when managing competing priorities.

Can confidently multitask and adapt to changing demands.

Enjoy building relationships and aren't afraid to pick up the phone to resolve issues quickly.

Have strong interpersonal skills and can influence stakeholders at all levels.

Are comfortable following process but confident enough to challenge when necessary.

Enjoy problem-solving and identifying smarter ways of working.

Have experience within compliance, onboarding, operations, customer service, contractor support or other process-driven environments.

Why Join Gattaca?

At Gattaca, you'll be part of a business that combines ambition with purpose. You'll work alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about delivering great outcomes for customers, candidates and each other.

We're committed to creating an environment where people can thrive, develop and make a meaningful impact.

Interested in joining us?
As an Onboarding Coordinator, you'll play a critical role in delivering a seamless contractor journey, ensuring compliance excellence and driving continuous improvement. If you're looking for a varied role where your contribution genuinely matters, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and be part of something bigger at Gattaca.

Recruitment Process

Gattaca is dedicated to helping our people to realise their full potential. We understand the value a diverse workforce brings to every workplace and in everything we do, we are committed to promoting diversity, inclusion and accessibility. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and encourage you to consider a career with Gattaca, if there is anything we can do to make our recruitment processes better for you, tell us.

Our recruitment process will include a combination of telephone, video and face to face interviews for you to showcase your talents and potential.

We offer reasonable adjustments to accommodate the needs of our applicants, such as providing interview questions in advance, offering written formats, changing interview times, structure, or settings, and arranging office visits before the interview. This list is not exhaustive, and we are open to considering any additional adjustments to support our candidates.

title: Recruitment Resourcer
description:
Prospero Group has been successfully placing teaching and support staff for over 20 years. Our network of schools, academies, and nurseries spans the UK and international markets. Our educational services are available in a wide range of educational settings; EYFS, Primary, Secondary, Further Education, SEN, and PRUs.

Looking for a career that offers meaningful work and a chance to make a difference?

At Prospero Group, you'll have the opportunity to build strong relationships with schools and teaching staff, while also reaching for the stars in terms of targets and commission. With a supportive team environment, excellent commission rates, and plenty of room for personal growth, this is a chance to join a company that truly values its people.

Prospero Group are delighted to be recruiting a Recruitment Resourcer to join our Southampton team!

In this role you will be responsible for-
- Conducting telephone interviews with prospective candidates to establish suitability for various roles
- Advertising vacancies on job boards within company guidelines
- Sourcing candidates via social media, job boards, CV searching, and our branch network
- Working with the team to coordinate each stage from initial application through to offer of employment
- Supporting with candidate mailers
- Data entry/ administration

What we are looking for-
- Driven, hungry and motivated individuals with a 'winning' attitude!
- Willingness to learn
- Strong written and communication skills
- Positive and 'can do' attitude
- Graduate or equivalent desirable
- Competitive and target driven

Experience within a similar role is desirable.

You must be able to demonstrate a proven track record in your field, whether it be in work, education, or sport! We are always looking for individuals with the hard-working mindset that is looking to apply themselves to a new challenge.

This is a great opportunity to learn the foundations of recruitment and grow!

What We Offer:
- Industry-leading OTE
- Great holidays plus your birthday off!
- Target-based incentives and rewards
- Career progression based entirely on your personal achievement
- Opportunity to become a team leader or manager very quickly
- Industry-leading training throughout your career
- A culture that motivates, excites and stimulates
- Monthly company social events

If you're ambitious, financially motivated, competitive, and interested in joining a growing business with a group of like-minded people, then Prospero has the career you're looking for!

title: Resourcer
company: Find Recruitment Group LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Talent Partner / Resourcer

STEM Education & Training Fareham

FIND is a specialist recruitment business with a simple belief: great recruitment is built on great sales, deep market knowledge and treating people properly. We're relentless about winning, and equally relentless about improving the perception of staffing agencies. That means creating outstanding opportunities for candidates and helping clients secure the talent that makes a difference.

The opportunity

You will build relationships with exceptional people across STEM education and technical training, understand what motivates them and connect them with opportunities that genuinely move their careers forward.

What you will own
- Build and maintain a network of teaching, training and technical education talent.
- Get curious about people: their skills, ambitions, frustrations and what would make them move.
- Find and engage hard-to-reach candidates, not just the people already applying.
- Work closely with our consultants to deliver on client commitments, with pace, accuracy and care.
- Learn to qualify properly, manage expectations and create an outstanding candidate experience.

Who will thrive here

You might be starting your recruitment career, but you won't be starting without a plan. We want energy, curiosity, confidence, empathy and a willingness to do the work others avoid. You will be measured on the quality of the networks you build and the commitments you deliver.

What you get
- Salary depending on experience
- 300 /placement (Talent Partners) & 25% - 35% commission (Consultants)
- 30 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Christmas shutdown
- Two holiday incentives each year
- Private medical cover after successful six-month probation
- Enhanced pension scheme
- A substantial sales enablement and candidate sourcing tech stack
- Ongoing learning, development and sales coaching
- Four days a week in our Fareham office
